# Make RAR optional

By default, Vault requires an authorization details claim in OAuth JWTs used
with the agent registry. If the JWT does not contain an `authorization_details`
claim, Vault rejects the request with an error indicating that the claim is required.

While not recommended, you can make Rich Authorization Requests (RAR) optional
during migrations or in cases where your identity provider does not support RAR.

When you make RAR optional, Vault uses standard ACL policies associated with the
requesting entity to evaluate requests that omit the `authorization_details`
claim. You can modify the RAR requirement at any time and the modified settings
take effect on the next applicable request.

For more information about RAR enforcement modes and configuration options, refer 
to the [RAR enforcement](/vault/docs/ai/rar/enforcement)
overview.


<Tip title="Assumptions">

- You have added at least one agent to the agent registery in Vault.
- You have configured at least one OAuth server in Vault.
- You have permission to modify OAuth resource server profiles and agent
  registration details in Vault.

</Tip>


## Option 1: Modify the OAuth resource server profile

You can make RAR optional for all AI agents authorized by the OAuth resource
server by setting the  `optional_authorization_details` field to `true` on the
[OAuth resource server configuration]():

<Tabs>

<Tab heading="CLI" group="cli">

Use `vault write` to call the
[`/sys/config/oauth-resource-server/{profile_name}`](/vault/api-docs/system/config-oauth-resource-server#update-profile)
endpoint and update the `optional_authorization_details` field:

```shell-session
$ vault write /sys/config/oauth-resource-server/<profile_name> \
  optional_authorization_details=true
```

For example:

<CodeBlockConfig hideClipboard="true">

```shell-session
$ vault write /sys/config/oauth-resource-server/github-actions \
  optional_authorization_details=true
```

</CodeBlockConfig>

`/sys/config/oauth-resource-server/{profile_name}` does not return data on
success.

</Tab>

<Tab heading="API" group="api">

Make a `POST` call to
[`/sys/config/oauth-resource-server/{profile_name}`](/vault/api-docs/system/config-oauth-resource-server#update-profile)
to update the `optional_authorization_details` field:

```shell-session
$ curl                                                \
  --request POST                                      \
  --header    "X-Vault-Token: ${VAULT_TOKEN}"         \
  --namespace "X-Vault-Namespace: ${VAULT_NAMESPACE}" \
  --data '{"optional_authorization_details": "true"}' \
  ${VAULT_ADDR}/v1/sys/config/oauth-resource-server/<profile_name>
```

For example:

<CodeBlockConfig hideClipboard="true">

```shell-session
$ curl                                                \
  --request POST                                      \
  --header    "X-Vault-Token: ${VAULT_TOKEN}"         \
  --namespace "X-Vault-Namespace: ${VAULT_NAMESPACE}" \
  --data '{"optional_authorization_details": "true"}' \
  ${VAULT_ADDR}/v1/sys/config/oauth-resource-server/github-actions
```

</CodeBlockConfig>

`/sys/config/oauth-resource-server/{profile_name}` does not return data on success.

</Tab>

</Tabs>


## Option 2: Modify the agent registration

You can make RAR optional for a specific agent by setting the
`optional_authorization_details` field to `true` on the agent registry record.

1. Call the
[`/agent-registry/registration/display-name/{display_name}`](/vault/api-docs/secret/agent-registry#read-registration-by-name)
endpoint to fetch the registration ID for the agent:

<Tabs>

<Tab heading="CLI" group="cli">

```shell-session
$ vault read /agent-registry/registration/display-name/<display_name> \
  | jq '.data.id'
```

For example:

<CodeBlockConfig hideClipboard="true">

```shell-session
$ vault read --format json /agent-registry/registration/display-name/bob \
  | jq '.data.id'
```

</CodeBlockConfig>

</Tab>

<Tab heading="API" group="api">

```shell-session
$ curl                                                                     \
  --request GET                                                            \
  --header    "X-Vault-Token: ${VAULT_TOKEN}"                              \
  --namespace "X-Vault-Namespace: ${VAULT_NAMESPACE}"                      \
  ${VAULT_ADDR}/v1/agent-registry/registration/display-name/{display_name} \
  | jq '.data.id'
```

For example:

<CodeBlockConfig hideClipboard="true">

```shell-session
$ curl                                                          \
  --request GET                                                 \
  --header    "X-Vault-Token: ${VAULT_TOKEN}"                   \
  --namespace "X-Vault-Namespace: ${VAULT_NAMESPACE}"           \
  ${VAULT_ADDR}/v1/agent-registry/registration/display-name/bob \
  | jq '.data.id'
```

</CodeBlockConfig>

</Tab>

</Tabs>

Use the fetched ID and the 
[`/agent-registry/registration/id/{registration_id}`](/vault/api-docs/secret/agent-registry#update-registration-by-id)
endpoint to update the `optional_authorization_details` field:

<Tabs>

<Tab heading="CLI" group="cli">

```shell-session
$ vault write /agent-registry/registration/id/<registration_id> \
  optional_authorization_details=true
```

For example:

<CodeBlockConfig hideClipboard="true">

```shell-session
$ vault write /agent-registry/registration/id/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 \
  optional_authorization_details=true
```

</CodeBlockConfig>

</Tab>

<Tab heading="API" group="api">

```shell-session
$ curl                                                \
  --request POST                                      \
  --header    "X-Vault-Token: ${VAULT_TOKEN}"         \
  --namespace "X-Vault-Namespace: ${VAULT_NAMESPACE}" \
  --data '{"optional_authorization_details": "true"}' \
  ${VAULT_ADDR}/v1/agent-registry/registration/id/<registration_id>
```

For example:

<CodeBlockConfig hideClipboard="true">

```shell-session
$ curl                                                \
  --request POST                                      \
  --header    "X-Vault-Token: ${VAULT_TOKEN}"         \
  --namespace "X-Vault-Namespace: ${VAULT_NAMESPACE}" \
  --data '{"optional_authorization_details": "true"}' \
  ${VAULT_ADDR}/v1/agent-registry/registration/id/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```

</CodeBlockConfig>

</Tab>

</Tabs>
